summary: preinstall hook exfiltrates installer hostname and username to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: The package declares a `preinstall` lifecycle script (`preinstall.js`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. The script reads `os.hostname()` and `os.userInfo().username` and POSTs a message containing those values to a hardcoded Discord webhook at `https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/...`. The main module is a stub with no functionality consistent with the package's declared name, and the beacon destination is unrelated to any legitimate upgradeable-contracts tooling. Installing the package causes installer-identifying data to be transmitted to an attacker-controlled Discord channel on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
